title: Oven Roasted Kenyan Peppers Skewers
description: A Whole30-friendly Kenyan dish featuring sweet peppadew peppers, roasted to perfection with binchotan-charcoal flavor, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread 2-3 peppadew peppers onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together coconut oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and binchotan charcoal powder if using.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the peppers, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the peppers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the roasted peppers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
